articles.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
articles.description: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.

articles.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
articles.description: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.

articles.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
articles.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

articles.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
articles.description: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

articles.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
articles.description: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

articles.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
articles.description: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

articles.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
articles.description: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

articles.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
articles.description: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

articles.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
articles.description: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

articles.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
articles.description: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.
